robot_description2: It's hard to fire a deforestation robot, but after years of safety violations, ignored protocol, and ethical complaints, bunsen burner robot Burner Man was out on unemployment. Now, someone of his spurred skills fit right in to King's army, and so King set him out on what he does best: burn. King always recognized best how to play his pawns, and so for Burner Man he goaded his inate pyromania. He lied, telling Burner Man that the humans had selfishly made his weaponry, his flames, his fire, too powerful to be withheld and contained, and if he didn't release that light, it would explode and consume him. With his mighty pyro-gas Wave Burner, Burner Man was unleashed into the world, all reason and mercy lost to the heat of his madness. He always enjoyed causing a lot of destruction, so if it was to survive, he figured, 'why the heck not'? In his free time, he loves contributing to greenhouse gas emissions by spraying aerasol cans, not carpooling, and investing in cryptocurrency. After all, he's gonna explode one day anyway - hey, why should he care? He's a little bit of a loon, but a great guy to have fighting for your team!
robot_skill_description: Drastically boosts the robot's attack on Flame-type fields
robot_skill_description2: The robot's attack stat is extraordinarily boosted by three stages when the Flame-type field multiplier is incredibly high.
robot_quotes_taunt: Play with fire, and you'll get burned!
robot_quotes_victory: I won't stop until the whole world is in flames!
robot_quotes_defeat: Ow, hot, hot! This isn't fun when I'm the one getting burned!
